title: Virtual Care Eligibility Matrix by Visit Type
content:
Each Virtual Care visit type has its own entry requirements and its own patient figures: whether new patients may use it, the lookback that makes a patient established, the minimum age, the age under which a parent or guardian must join, the in-person interval, and the weekly encounter limit.

## Entry requirements by visit type

| Visit type | Entry requirements |
|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | MyLinden portal status active; established patient; at least 18 years old |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | Established patient; video unavailable to the patient or declined by the patient |
| Primary Care Video Visit | MyLinden portal status active; located in a licensed state |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | MyLinden portal status active; behavioral health intake completed; located in a licensed state |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | MyLinden portal status active; prior in-person specialty visit; located in a licensed state |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | MyLinden portal status active; located in a licensed state; at least 2 years old |

## Definitions of the patient figures

- **New patients accepted** — whether patients with no completed visit in the group within the established-patient lookback may use the visit type (yes or no).
- **Established-patient lookback** — the number of months within which a completed visit in the group makes the patient established for the visit type.
- **Minimum age** — the youngest patient age served, in years.
- **Guardian joins under age** — the age, in years, under which a parent or guardian must join.
- **In-person interval** — the number of calendar months within which the patient must also have an in-person visit with the department for continued virtual care. A value of 0 means there is no such requirement.
- **Weekly encounter limit** — the maximum number of encounters of the visit type per patient in a rolling 7 days.

## Patient figures by visit type

| Visit type | New patients accepted | Established-patient lookback | Minimum age | Guardian joins under age | In-person interval | Weekly encounter limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | No | 36 months | 18 years | 18 years | 0 (no requirement) | 2 |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | No | 36 months | 0 years | 18 years | 12 calendar months | 2 |
| Primary Care Video Visit | Yes | 36 months | 0 years | 18 years | 12 calendar months | 2 |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | No | 36 months | 12 years | 16 years | 12 calendar months | 2 |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | No | 36 months | 0 years | 18 years | 12 calendar months | 2 |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | Yes | 36 months | 2 years | 18 years | 0 (no requirement) | 3 |

## Ages read against the table

| Visit type | Patient age | At or above the minimum age | Parent or guardian must join |
|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | 17 | No (minimum 18) | — |
| Portal E-Visit | 18 | Yes | No (18 is not under 18) |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 11 | No (minimum 12) | — |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 12 | Yes | Yes (12 is under 16) |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 16 | Yes | No (16 is not under 16) |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 1 | No (minimum 2) | — |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 2 | Yes | Yes (2 is under 18) |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 10 | Yes (minimum 0) | Yes (10 is under 18) |

Because the Portal E-Visit minimum age and its guardian age are both 18, no patient old enough for a Portal E-Visit is under its guardian age.

## Notes

- New patients may use the Primary Care Video Visit and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care; the other four visit types do not accept new patients.
- The established-patient lookback is 36 months on every visit type.
- On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care carries a weekly encounter limit of 3; every other visit type carries 2.
